messages.subject: For Arvind Krishna | AI, government partnerships and responsible innovation
messages.body:
Dear IBM Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Arvind Krishna, Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer.

IBM's leadership in AI, hybrid cloud and public-sector transformation increasingly operates at the intersection of governments, regulation, trust and responsible innovation. That environment aligns closely with the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, ESG, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate cross-functional responses across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, stakeholder strategy and emerging-market institutional experience might support IBM's global or regional priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to IBM.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
